values.name: Sun State Truck & Trailer Parts
values.noticeBody: Walk in at the counter, order ahead for pickup, or have parts delivered to your shop or job site.

values.heading: When we're open.
values.note: Brooksville is a parts store. Truck and trailer repairs run out of Tampa, Davenport and Sarasota, and our mobile service team can come to you.

values.heading: Parts on the shelf, north of Tampa.
values.body: When you need a part for your truck or trailer, Sun State has you covered. Our parts specialists stock a large inventory of genuine OEM and high-quality aftermarket components, and if something isn't immediately available we source it through our supplier network and our other locations to help minimize your downtime.

items.title: Truck parts
items.body: Filters, brakes, air and electrical components, aftertreatment and driveline parts for heavy and medium-duty trucks, all makes.

items.title: Trailer parts
items.body: Hyundai and all-makes trailer parts including running gear, landing gear, lighting, doors and liftgate components.

items.title: Order online
items.body: Search availability, price and order through the Sun State online parts store, then pick up in Brooksville or have it delivered.

items.title: Fleet accounts
items.body: Fleet Charge gives qualifying fleets consistent parts pricing and streamlined billing, with an in-house credit line available.

values.heading: Other Sun State locations.
values.body: Ready to find the right commercial trucks for your business? Visit us at our convenient locations across Central and Southwest Florida.

items.q: Where is the Brooksville parts store?
items.a: Sun State Truck & Trailer Parts is at 17127 Runway Drive, Brooksville, FL 34604, near the Brooksville-Tampa Bay Regional Airport industrial park. Call (352) 277-0221.

items.q: What are the Brooksville store hours?
items.a: The store is open 7:00 AM to 5:00 PM Monday through Friday, and closed Saturday and Sunday.

items.q: Does Brooksville offer pickup and delivery?
items.a: Yes. Brooksville offers in-store shopping, in-store pickup and delivery of parts.

items.q: What kind of parts does Brooksville stock?
items.a: Genuine OEM and high-quality aftermarket parts for heavy and medium-duty trucks and trailers, including Hyundai and all-makes trailer parts. Anything not on the shelf is sourced through our supplier network and the other Sun State locations.

items.q: Is service work done at Brooksville?
items.a: Brooksville is a parts store. Truck and trailer service is performed at our Tampa, Davenport and Sarasota dealerships, and our mobile service team can come to your location.

items.q: Can I order parts online instead?
items.a: Yes. Order through the Sun State online parts store at sunstateparts.com and pick up in Brooksville or have the parts delivered.

values.heading: Need a part today?
values.body: Call the counter with your VIN or unit number and we'll confirm what's in stock before you drive out.
